description: This file defines the interface ITransactionalBitArrayGrain used for transactional operations on a BitArray within Orleans framework testing and correctness validation.

classes.name: ITransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain that manages a transactional bit array, supporting operations like ping, set, and get within the Orleans distributed framework.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A method to check connectivity or responsiveness of the grain.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets the bit array to a new value within a transactional context.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the bit array, returning a list of BitArrayState objects.
